facts: The complete1080body-application replay separates clip work, wrench work after clipping and observed rounding residual.
Positive work after clipping can coexist with non-increasing combined application KE; native passive prediction uses earlier sampled velocity.
Correction potential is separate and no global mechanical-energy conservation or promotion follows.
